title: Water dripping out of a ceiling light
description: Water is dripping out of the ceiling light above the north desks and pooling on the carpet below it.
rationale: rule 1: the light is where the water appears, a leak is the cause

title: Monitor wet from a ceiling drip
description: There is a brown stain on the ceiling over Desk 3A-02 and drops of water keep landing on the external screen.

title: Network closet is overheating
description: The small network closet on floor 3 is hot enough that the switches are throwing fan alarms. The air in there is not moving.

title: Musty smell from the ceiling vent
description: A musty, damp smell comes out of the ceiling vent in Juniper every time the air turns on.

title: Sink overflowing onto the restroom floor
description: The left sink in the third floor restroom overflows when the tap runs and the floor around it is soaked.
rationale: rule 5: plumbing, not a cleaning spill

title: Thermostat screen is blank
description: The wall thermostat in Redwood has a blank screen and the room has been getting warmer all day.

title: Condensation pooling under the window
description: Every morning there is a puddle on the sill and floor under the big window by Desk 2A-03 from condensation.

title: Toilet overflowing in the men's room
description: The second stall toilet in the floor 2 men's room is overflowing and water is spreading under the partition.

title: Air in Alder feels stale
description: After about an hour in Alder the air feels stale and a few people in my meeting got headaches.

title: Hissing radiator valve
description: The valve on the radiator under the lounge window hisses loudly and spits a little water onto the floor.

title: Motorized desk has no power
description: The motorized desk at 2B-04 does not respond at all. The control panel has no lights and the outlet it plugs into seems dead.

title: Interactive whiteboard will not wake
description: The interactive whiteboard screen in Sequoia stays black when touched and the remote does nothing.
rationale: it is a display, not a dry-erase board

title: Restroom lights are out
description: Half of the lights in the floor 3 women's restroom are out and it is hard to see near the sinks.

title: Exit sign is dark
description: The exit sign above the north stairwell door is not lit anymore.

title: Badge reader on the lab door is dead
description: The badge reader next to the floor 3 lab door shows no light and the door will not unlock with a badge.
rationale: rule 3: no power, despite door and lock words

title: Projector screen motor stuck
description: The motorized projector screen in Alder is stuck halfway down and the wall switch does nothing.

title: Frayed extension cord under the bench
description: The extension cord feeding the bench desks is frayed near the plug and someone wrapped it in tape.

title: Kitchen TV shows an error
description: The TV in the kitchen shows a 'no input' error box and the menu button does nothing.

title: Hand dryer stopped working
description: The hand dryer in the floor 2 restroom does not start when you put your hands under it.

title: Ceiling speaker buzzing on calls
description: The ceiling speaker in Madrone makes a loud buzz whenever a video call starts, so people cannot hear.

title: Door slams shut
description: The closer on the door to the quiet room is broken, so the door slams every time someone lets go of it.

title: Monitor arm sagging
description: The monitor arm at Desk 3B-01 will not hold its position; the screen slowly drops to the desk.

title: Cable tray fell off the desk
description: The cable tray under Desk 2A-02 came loose from its screws and is hanging by the cables.

title: Window blind stuck
description: The blind on the west window of Juniper is stuck half open; the cord is tangled and will not pull.

title: Cracked toilet seat
description: The toilet seat in the accessible restroom on floor 2 is cracked across the front.

title: Stall lock broken
description: The lock on the third stall door in the floor 3 restroom is broken and the door swings open.

title: Kitchen cabinet door hanging
description: One of the upper kitchen cabinet doors has a broken hinge and is hanging at an angle.

title: Desk wobbles at every height
description: Desk 3A-03 wobbles side to side even at its lowest height; one leg seems loose.

title: Whiteboard will not erase
description: The whiteboard in Cypress leaves gray ghost marks that will not come off even with cleaner.

title: Coat rack bent
description: The coat rack by reception tipped over and one of its arms is now bent.

title: Slippery floor by the water cooler
description: Someone knocked over the water jug by the cooler and the floor there is still slippery.

title: Rotten smell from the fridge
description: The kitchen fridge smells rotten when opened; something has been left in there for a while.

title: Cords stretched across the walkway
description: Power cords from the bench desks are stretched across the main walkway and two people tripped this morning.
rationale: rule 4: intact cords as a hazard

title: Thick dust on the AV cart
description: The AV cart in Madrone is covered in thick dust and people keep sneezing during meetings.

title: Mouse near the server room
description: I saw a mouse run along the wall outside the server room on floor 3.
rationale: rule 7: pest, despite the word mouse

title: Broken picture frame glass
description: A picture frame fell off the wall in the hallway and the glass is in pieces on the floor.

title: Soap dispenser dripping
description: The soap dispenser by the kitchen sink drips soap all over the counter.

title: Wet floor with no sign
description: The lobby floor was just mopped, there is no wet floor sign, and it is very slick.

title: Sticky hot-desk surfaces
description: All the hot desks near the windows are sticky, like something sugary was wiped around.

title: Slush tracked in at the entrance
description: Rain and grit tracked in at the main entrance have made the entrance mats soaked and slippery.
